parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no participating record details: the `members` array is empty and all `structural_evidence` fields (`differing_slots`, `jaccard`, `shared_ancestor`, `shared_field_count`) are null. Without field lists, method signatures, context flags, or any other grounded evidence about `Announcement` in `_Plant_Announcement.swift` or `Breakpoint` in `PlaylistEntry.swift`, no refactor recommendation can be made without hallucinating evidence. The cluster_id encodes a subset-pairs signal between these two types in the `Shared/Playlist` package, but the absence of populated member data makes it impossible to verify whether the structural overlap is meaningful or merely coincidental.
